drop_patches.name: fix-metadata-gzip-double-decode.patch
drop_patches.reason: Upstream metadata header cleanup supersedes the Ubuntu gzip workaround: checks payload magic, removes stale content-encoding for decoded bodies, preserves compressed user data, and also recalculates content-length/transfer-encoding. Commit is an ancestor of pinned Hibiscus SHA; retain its complete implementation.

drop_patches.name: lp2150285-keep-mod-wsgi-operational.patch
drop_patches.reason: Hibiscus upstream implements server-agnostic worker election and group start-time, plus explicit mod_wsgi worker count support (ancestor commits 51cf77e, 8056655, 05d53ab). Retain upstream implementation and test_wsgi_utils regression suite; downstream one-cycle shim targets deleted get_api_worker_id API and says to drop when upstream supports mod_wsgi.
